items.title: Gartner Shares Jump After Strong Second-Quarter Performance and Higher Guidance

items.title: Gartner (IT) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
items.summary: Gartner (IT) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +15.92% and +1.80%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Gartner (NYSE:IT) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q2 CY2026, Stock Soars
items.summary: Research and advisory firm Gartner (NYSE:IT) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, but sales were flat year on year at $1.68 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.37 per share was 17.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
